prompt:
The section file sections/app-download-panel.liquid shows store badges for a mobile app. Its markup loops over section.blocks with limit: 3 and skips (continue) any badge whose store_url is blank. Do NOT change the markup. Replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %} block so that it is exactly this schema (same keys, values and array order):

Top-level keys:
- "name": "App download"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "app-download-section"
- "settings" (in this order):
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Get the app"
  2. type "textarea", id "description", label "Description" (no default)
- "blocks": exactly one block type: type "store_badge", name "Store badge", with settings (in this order):
  1. type "select", id "store", label "Store", options (in this order) {"value": "apple", "label": "App Store"} then {"value": "google", "label": "Google Play"}, default "apple"
  2. type "url", id "store_url", label "Store link" (no default)
  3. type "text", id "label", label "Badge text", default "Download"
- "max_blocks": 3 (number), matching the loop limit so merchants cannot add badges that would never render.
- "presets": one preset with name "App download" and "blocks" containing exactly two entries in this order: {"type": "store_badge", "settings": {"store": "apple"}} and {"type": "store_badge", "settings": {"store": "google"}}.

No other keys may be present anywhere in the schema. Change only sections/app-download-panel.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
